metadata.description: A collection of Claude Code skills for creating Spring Boot applications with proper architecture patterns

plugins.name: springboot-architecture
plugins.description: Skills for creating, testing and reviewing Spring Boot projects with architecture patterns (Layered to DDD+Hexagonal)

plugins.name: mattpocock-picks
plugins.description: Eight of Matt Pocock's engineering skills, unchanged and pinned: grilling, pr, tdd, diagnosing-bugs, prototype, domain-modeling, handoff and writing-for-agents. The full set is at github.com/mattpocock/skills.

plugins.name: html-plan
plugins.description: Thariq Shihipar's html-plan, pinned: an implementation plan as one interactive HTML page, with the decisions placed where they matter.

plugins.name: grill-page
plugins.description: The grill-page skill from build-compass, pinned: a grilling interview where each round opens as a page of clickable options.

plugins.name: pstack
plugins.description: Lauren Tan's pstack, pinned and optional: rigorous agent workflows such as technical-writing, unslop, blast-radius and correct. Most of its skills run only when you type them.
